proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Shareholder Proxy Access Enhancement
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend proxy access bylaws to remove any limit on the number of stockholders that can aggregate shares to meet the 3% nominating threshold.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 5.

proposals.title: Proposal 6
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy prohibiting continued vesting of equity awards for senior executives who voluntarily resign to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 6.

proposals.title: Proposal 7 – Special Shareholder Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws to give holders of 15% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowner meeting.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 7.
